service: kijani-capstone

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ${opt:region, 'af-south-1'}
  environment:
    DEFAULT_CURRENCY: KES
    PROCESSED_BUCKET: ${self:custom.processedBucket}
    NOTIFICATIONS_BUCKET: ${self:custom.notificationsBucket}
    ANALYTICS_BUCKET: ${self:custom.analyticsBucket}
plugins:
  - serverless-offline
  - serverless-s3-local

functions:

  generateReceipt:
    handler: handlers/receipts.generateReceipt
    events:
      - http:
          path: receipts
          method: post

  processReceiptUpload:
    handler: handlers/receipts.processReceiptUpload
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.receiptsBucket}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          existing: false

  processReceipt:
    handler: handlers/processor.processReceipt
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.processedBucket}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          existing: false
  notifyReceipt:
    handler: handlers/notifier.notifyReceipt
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.notificationsBucket}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          existing: false

  analyzeReceipts:
    handler: handlers/analytics.analyzeReceipts
    events:
      - s3:
          bucket: ${self:custom.analyticsBucket}
          event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
          existing: false
resources:
  Resources:

    ReceiptsBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.receiptsBucket}

    ProcessedBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.processedBucket}

    NotificationsBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.notificationsBucket}
    AnalyticsBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        BucketName: ${self:custom.analyticsBucket}
custom:

  receiptsBucket: kijani-payments-receipts-${self:provider.stage}

  processedBucket: kijani-payments-processed-${self:provider.stage}

  notificationsBucket: kijani-payments-notifications-${self:provider.stage}

  analyticsBucket: kijani-payments-analytics-${self:provider.stage}
  
  s3:
    host: localhost
    port: 4569
    directory: /tmp/kijani-s3-local
    accessKeyId: S3RVER
    secretAccessKey: S3RVER
